meitzav.rule: All 36 numbered source questions have final disposition with canonical evidence or explicit out-of-scope/duplicate proof.

officialCurriculum.rule: All 23 normalized current Ministry requirements for linear functions, linear inequalities and first-degree systems have explicit canonical evidence.

completionRule: Coverage is complete only when every mandatory source has a source-item ledger and every relevant item has a final disposition: included, merged, verified_duplicate or out_of_scope.
